AddrCount.description_en: The number of addresses in the address pool

AddrPoolId.description_en: The ID of the address pool

Addr.description_en: The addresses in the address pool

AlertStatus.description_en:
The health check status of the address.

OK: Normal

ALERT: Alert
AlertStatus.description_zh:
健康检查状态：

OK：正常
ALERT：报警

AttributeInfo.description_en:
The source region of the address.

LineCode: The line code of the source region. This parameter is deprecated. Use LineCodes instead.

LineName: The name of the source region. This parameter is deprecated.

LineCodes: A list of line codes for the source regions
AttributeInfo.description_zh:
地址归属信息。

LineCode：归属线路code。（已废弃，以LineCodes数据为准）
LineName：归属线路名称。（已废弃）
LineCodes：归属线路列表

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the address was created

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The time when the address was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp

Mode.description_en:
The mode of the address.

SMART: Smart return

ONLINE: Always online

OFFLINE: Always offline
Mode.description_zh:
模式：

SMART：智能返回
ONLINE：永远在线
OFFLINE：永远离线

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the address was last updated

UpdateTimestamp.description_en: The time when the address was last updated. This value is a UNIX timestamp

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the address pool was created

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The time when the address pool was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp

LbaStrategy.description_en:
The load balancing policy.

ALL_RR: Returns all addresses.

RATIO: Returns addresses by weight
LbaStrategy.description_zh:
负载均衡策略：

ALL_RR: 返回全部地址
RATIO：按权重返回地址

MonitorConfigId.description_en: The ID of the health check configuration

The health check status of the address pool.

OPEN: Enabled

CLOSE: Disabled

UNCONFIGURED: Not configured
MonitorStatus.description_zh:
监控状态：

OPEN：开启
CLOSE：关闭
UNCONFIGURED：未配置

Name.description_en: The name of the address pool

IPV4: IPv4 address

IPV6: IPv6 address

DOMAIN: Domain name
Type.description_zh:
地址池类型：

IPV4：ipv4地址
